Subject: Renewal settlement: final ledger handoff & VAT substantiation plan

Hi Rishi,

Thanks for the partnership — we're in the last stretch before the renewal term starts on Oct 1. Attached is our current run-down of charges for the EOT reconciliation (datastream_final_rundown.csv). High-level: we have a ~€42,300 outstanding usage variance and a pro-rated renewal credit that needs to be applied. We want to close the ledger and get the final invoices issued before Sep 20 to hit our month-end cut.

Requests:
- Can Redwood issue the final reconciliation invoice (usage delta) and a separate renewal invoice for the committed portion?
- We will provide an EU VAT registration certificate and a PO number (see below) — please confirm what specific VAT substantiation you need for the invoice to process a cross-border payment.
- Bank details for the wire will be shared after invoices are issued; our AP needs invoice references for the PO.

PO: DS-PO-99821
Attached: datastream_final_rundown.csv (CSV)

If easier, we can hop on a 20-min call tomorrow morning CET to walk the numbers.

Regards,
Alice Chen
CFO, Datastream AI
alice.chen@datastream.ai

Subject: Re: Renewal settlement: final ledger handoff & VAT substantiation plan

Thanks Alice — and really appreciate the clear packet. We can absolutely get this wrapped before your month-end. Next steps from Redwood:

1) Internal reconciliation: I'll have Marissa produce two invoice drafts: (a) reconciliation invoice for the outstanding usage delta, (b) renewal invoice covering the pro-rated commitment.
2) VAT substantiation: Can you confirm a PDF of your VAT registration (certificate) plus the registered VAT number used on invoices? That will allow us to flag the invoices correctly for EU tax handling.
3) Timing: Target to send draft invoices for your review by Sep 14 and final invoices by Sep 17 so you can initiate payment.
4) Call: I can do a 20-min call at 10:00 CET tomorrow (Sep 8) if that works — propose to keep AP and billing on for quick sign-off.

I've attached our reconciliation template to align formats (redwood_recon_template.xlsx). Marissa — can you take the ledger Alice sent and draft the two invoices and include a clear VAT field mapping?

Rishi
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.example.com

Hi Alice — thanks for sending the run-down. I pulled the file into our template and attached an updated ledger (final_ledger_v2.csv) with our line-by-line mapping. A few operational notes so AP can process without delays:

- Invoice sequencing: we'll issue two separate invoices as requested — Invoice R-2027-998 (reconciliation usage delta, €42,300) and Invoice R-2027-999 (pro-rated renewal commitment, €18,750). We will include the PO DS-PO-99821 on both invoices.
- VAT handling: to apply the appropriate EU handling we need a copy of your VAT registration (PDF) that exactly matches the name on your PO. Please send the PDF and confirm the VAT number string (e.g., GB123456789). If you expect reverse-charge treatment, confirm the buyer-side VAT ID as well.
- Payment terms: standard 30 days from invoice date. If Datastream needs earlier settlement, we can agree on a staged payoff; please confirm.

DocuSign: I've also sent the updated SOW amendment for the renewal billing terms (link below) so legal/billing can sign quickly.

DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/putative/sign/ABCD-1234

Attachments: final_ledger_v2.csv (CSV)

Marissa Cole
